source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U04: Separate financial assistance, financial asset and the property securing it

facts.statement: Financial assistance includes loans, advances, subscribed bonds/debentures, guarantees, LCs, other facilities and stated later asset-finance/intangible/debt-security additions. Financial asset includes debt/receivables and specified secured or unsecured rights. Property includes movables, immovables, receivables and described intangibles.

payload.title: Credit facility, claim and collateral answer different questions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Financial assistance describes the credit support: the definition reaches beyond a cash loan to the stated advances, subscriptions, guarantees, letters of credit and other facilities. The courseware also records the described asset-finance, intangible-right and debt-security additions. Financial asset concerns the debt, receivable or specified right, which can include an unsecured claim.

Property is wider than land: it can include movables, rights to payment, future receivables and the described intangible rights. A claim being a financial asset does not prove that it carries enforceable security over a particular property. Examine the security relationship separately; otherwise a definition about transferable claims becomes an unsupported enforcement conclusion.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every financial asset necessarily have identified immovable collateral?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Financial assets include the specified unsecured claims and other rights.

payload.stem_md: A transferred portfolio contains an unsecured receivable. A learner says it cannot be a financial asset because no mortgage exists. What is the correct distinction?

options.text_md: The financial-asset definition includes specified unsecured debt/receivable claims
options.explanation_md: The definition is wider than mortgage-backed loans.

options.text_md: Every receivable necessarily creates a mortgage
options.explanation_md: A receivable does not create a missing mortgage automatically.

options.text_md: A financial asset must always be physical land
options.explanation_md: The definition includes debt, receivables and described rights.

options.text_md: Removing the debtor name converts the claim into cash
options.explanation_md: Record changes do not establish payment or alter the nature of the claim.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definition is wider than mortgage-backed loans.

payload.stem_md: A company offers a right to future receivables for a proposed security arrangement. What preliminary conclusion fits the defined property concept?

options.text_md: Only registered land can ever be property under the Act
options.explanation_md: The definition is broader than immovable property.

options.text_md: The receivables are automatically collected in cash once described
options.explanation_md: A property description is not proof of collection.

options.text_md: Future receivables can fall within property, but valid security and enforcement require separate checks
options.explanation_md: Recognising the property category does not establish all legal conditions.

options.text_md: Future rights can never be included because they are not present cash
options.explanation_md: The definition expressly includes existing or future receivables.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Recognising the property category does not establish all legal conditions.
